issues.existing: the blindfold covers the eyes while the body faces the light
issues.observed: the bright canopy break is BEHIND her; she walks down the path toward the viewer, backlit, with her back to the light
issues.evidence: The single light source is a sun shaft breaking through the canopy at upper centre-right, which falls on the path behind her and rims her shoulders; her feet and body advance toward the bottom of the frame.

issues.existing: the cloth binds her hands and head yet trails loose and free
issues.observed: only the head/eyes are wound; both hands are free — her left hand grips the shawl edge at her chest, her right arm hangs down and out with fingers open
issues.evidence: No cloth passes around either wrist; the pale strips hang from the shawl and the head wrap across the skirt, not from her hands.

issues.existing: a surrounding ring of blades that is present but not touching
issues.observed: not a ring — two loose flanking groups (roughly 4 left, 5 right) with a clear open lane of empty water directly in front of and behind her
issues.evidence: The water immediately fore and aft of the figure is unbroken; every blade sits to her left or right at varying depths, so the shape is open on two sides, not closed.

issues.observed: the whole image is high-key, pale and luminous with a bright diffuse glow; I could not determine night vs pale daylight from the pixels despite the crescent moon
issues.evidence: Values are near-white across sky, mist and water with no dark passages anywhere; only the crescent implies night.

issues.existing: silver linework on a deep blue-lavender night ground
issues.observed: the ground is very pale and high-key — white-and-pale-blue clouded sky with a bright glittering light path on the sea; it reads far closer to daylight than to a night ground, though a crescent moon is present
issues.evidence: Sky, sea and drapery are all near-white in value; there is no dark field anywhere in the frame. I recorded day-vs-night as undeterminable, so I flag rather than overturn.
